<file path="alte_gui/frontend/src/shared/state/laneStores.ts">
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';

// ========== FAST LANE: rAF + RingBuffer ==========
type Listener = () => void;

class RingBuffer<T> {
  private array: T[];
  private index = 0;
  private filled = false;

  constructor(private capacity: number) {
    this.array = new Array<T>(capacity);
  }

  push(value: T) {
    this.array[this.index] = value;
    this.index = (this.index + 1) % this.capacity;
    if (this.index === 0) this.filled = true;
  }

  drain(): T[] {
    const output: T[] = [];
    if (!this.filled && this.index === 0) return output;
    
    if (!this.filled) {
      // Partially filled - return from start to index
      for (let k = 0; k < this.index; k++) {
        output.push(this.array[k]!);
      }
      this.index = 0;
      return output;
    }
    
    // Fully filled - return from index (oldest) to end, then start to index
    for (let k = 0; k < this.capacity; k++) {
      output.push(this.array[(this.index + k) % this.capacity]!);
    }
    this.index = 0;
    this.filled = false;
    return output;
  }
}

type FastState = {
  version: number;
  snapshot: any;
  buffer: RingBuffer<any>;
  rafId: number | null;
  listeners: Set<Listener>;
  reducer?: (batch: any[], prev: any) => any;
};

const fastMap = new Map<string, FastState>();

function getFastState(key: string, reducer?: FastState['reducer']): FastState {
  let state = fastMap.get(key);
  if (!state) {
    state = {
      version: 0,
      snapshot: null,
      buffer: new RingBuffer(2048), // 2048 events max per frame
      rafId: null,
      listeners: new Set(),
      reducer
    };
    fastMap.set(key, state);
  }
  if (reducer && !state.reducer) {
    state.reducer = reducer;
  }
  return state;
}

function scheduleFastFlush(state: FastState) {
  if (state.rafId !== null) return;
  
  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    state.rafId = null;
    const batch = state.buffer.drain();
    if (batch.length) {
      state.snapshot = state.reducer 
        ? state.reducer(batch, state.snapshot)
        : batch[batch.length - 1];
      state.version++;
      state.listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
    }
  });
}

export function fastPush(key: string, payload: any, reducer?: FastState['reducer']) {
  const state = getFastState(key, reducer);
  state.buffer.push(payload);
  scheduleFastFlush(state);
}

export function useFastSnapshot<T = any>(key: string): T | null {
  const state = getFastState(key);
  
  const subscribe = (listener: Listener) => {
    state.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => state.listeners.delete(listener);
  };
  
  const getSnapshot = () => state.version;
  
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
  return state.snapshot as T | null;
}

// ========== MIDDLE LANE: Microtask Batch ==========
type MiddleState = {
  version: number;
  map: Map<string, any>;
  queue: Array<{ key: string; payload: any }>;
  isEnqueued: boolean;
  listeners: Set<Listener>;
};

const middleState: MiddleState = {
  version: 0,
  map: new Map(),
  queue: [],
  isEnqueued: false,
  listeners: new Set()
};

function flushMiddle() {
  if (!middleState.queue.length) return;
  
  for (const { key, payload } of middleState.queue) {
    middleState.map.set(key, payload);
  }
  middleState.queue.length = 0;
  middleState.version++;
  middleState.listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
}

export function middlePush(key: string, payload: any) {
  middleState.queue.push({ key, payload });
  
  if (!middleState.isEnqueued) {
    middleState.isEnqueued = true;
    queueMicrotask(() => {
      middleState.isEnqueued = false;
      flushMiddle();
    });
  }
}

export function useMiddleState<T = any>(key: string): T | undefined {
  const subscribe = (listener: Listener) => {
    middleState.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => middleState.listeners.delete(listener);
  };
  
  const getSnapshot = () => middleState.version;
  
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
  return middleState.map.get(key) as T | undefined;
}

// ========== SLOW LANE: Immediate Map Updates ==========
type SlowState = {
  version: number;
  map: Map<string, any>;
  listeners: Set<Listener>;
};

const slowState: SlowState = {
  version: 0,
  map: new Map(),
  listeners: new Set()
};

export function slowReplace(key: string, value: any) {
  slowState.map.set(key, value);
  slowState.version++;
  slowState.listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
}

export function slowUpsertMerge(key: string, partialValue: any) {
  const existing = slowState.map.get(key) || {};
  const merged = Array.isArray(existing) ? partialValue : { ...existing, ...partialValue };
  slowState.map.set(key, merged);
  slowState.version++;
  slowState.listeners.forEach(listener => listener());
}

export function useSlow<T = any>(key: string): T | undefined {
  const subscribe = (listener: Listener) => {
    slowState.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => slowState.listeners.delete(listener);
  };
  
  const getSnapshot = () => slowState.version;
  
  useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
  return slowState.map.get(key) as T | undefined;
}

// ========== DEBUG UTILITIES ==========
export function getLaneStats() {
  return {
    fast: {
      keys: fastMap.size,
      totalListeners: Array.from(fastMap.values()).reduce((sum, state) => sum + state.listeners.size, 0)
    },
    middle: {
      keys: middleState.map.size,
      listeners: middleState.listeners.size,
      queueSize: middleState.queue.length
    },
    slow: {
      keys: slowState.map.size,
      listeners: slowState.listeners.size
    }
  };
}
</file>

<file path="alte_gui/frontend/src/shared/state/SettingsProvider.tsx">
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useFastSnapshot } from './laneStores';
import { getSettings } from '../../shared/api/trading';

export interface SettingsProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

export function SettingsProvider({ children }: SettingsProviderProps) {
  const settings = useFastSnapshot<any[]>('settings');
  
  useEffect(() => {
    // Initial load if no settings
    if (!settings || !settings.length) {
      console.log('[SettingsProvider] Loading initial settings...');
      getSettings();
    }
    
    // Auto-refresh on window focus
    const handleFocus = () => {
      console.log('[SettingsProvider] Window focus - refreshing settings');
      getSettings();
    };
    
    // Periodic refresh every minute
    const intervalId = setInterval(() => {
      console.log('[SettingsProvider] Periodic refresh - reloading settings');
      getSettings();
    }, 60_000);
    
    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    
    return () => {
      clearInterval(intervalId);
      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);
    };
  }, [settings?.length]);
  
  return <>{children}</>;
}
</file>

import { useTheme } from "../../hooks/use-theme";

const ThemeToggle = () => {
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    switch (theme) {
      case "light":
        setTheme("dark");
        break;
      case "dark":
        setTheme("system");
        break;
      case "system":
        setTheme("light");
        break;
    }
  };

  const getIcon = () => {
    switch (theme) {
      case "light":
        return (
          <svg
            width="20"
            height="20"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          >
            <circle
              cx="12"
              cy="12"
              r="5"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
            />
            <path
              d="M12 1v2M12 21v2M4.22 4.22l1.42 1.42M18.36 18.36l1.42 1.42M1 12h2M21 12h2M4.22 19.78l1.42-1.42M18.36 5.64l1.42-1.42"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
            />
          </svg>
        );
      case "dark":
        return (
          <svg
            width="20"
            height="20"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          >
            <path
              d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1111.21 3 7 7 0 0021 12.79z"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
              fill="currentColor"
            />
          </svg>
        );
      case "system":
        return (
          <svg
            width="20"
            height="20"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          >
            <rect
              x="2"
              y="4"
              width="20"
              height="14"
              rx="2"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
            />
            <path d="M8 20h8" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" />
            <path d="M12 16v4" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" />
          </svg>
        );
    }
  };

  const getTooltip = () => {
    switch (theme) {
      case "light":
        return "Hell-Modus";
      case "dark":
        return "Dunkel-Modus";
      case "system":
        return "System-Modus";
    }
  };

  return (
    <button
      onClick={toggleTheme}
      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded font-medium transition-colors ${"text-foreground hover:bg-muted"}`}
      title={getTooltip()}
      aria-label={`Aktueller Modus: ${getTooltip()}. Klicken zum Wechseln.`}
    >
      {getIcon()}
    </button>
  );
};

export default ThemeToggle;
</file>

<file path="alte_gui/frontend/src/shared/ui/virtualized-list.tsx">
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';

interface VirtualizedListProps<T> {
  items: T[];
  itemHeight: number;
  containerHeight: number;
  renderItem: (item: T, index: number) => React.ReactNode;
  overscan?: number;
  className?: string;
}

export function VirtualizedList<T>({
  items,
  itemHeight,
  containerHeight,
  renderItem,
  overscan = 5,
  className = ""
}: VirtualizedListProps<T>) {
  const [scrollTop, setScrollTop] = useState(0);
  const scrollElementRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const visibleRange = useMemo(() => {
    const startIndex = Math.max(0, Math.floor(scrollTop / itemHeight) - overscan);
    const endIndex = Math.min(
      items.length - 1,
      Math.ceil((scrollTop + containerHeight) / itemHeight) + overscan
    );
    return { startIndex, endIndex };
  }, [scrollTop, itemHeight, containerHeight, items.length, overscan]);

  const visibleItems = useMemo(() => {
    return items.slice(visibleRange.startIndex, visibleRange.endIndex + 1);
  }, [items, visibleRange]);

  const totalHeight = items.length * itemHeight;
  const offsetY = visibleRange.startIndex * itemHeight;

  const handleScroll = (e: React.UIEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    setScrollTop(e.currentTarget.scrollTop);
  };

  return (
    <div
      ref={scrollElementRef}
      className={`overflow-auto ${className}`}
      style={{ height: containerHeight }}
      onScroll={handleScroll}
    >
      <div style={{ height: totalHeight, position: 'relative' }}>
        <div style={{ transform: `translateY(${offsetY}px)` }}>
          {visibleItems.map((item, index) => (
            <div
              key={visibleRange.startIndex + index}
              style={{ height: itemHeight }}
            >
              {renderItem(item, visibleRange.startIndex + index)}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
</file>

<file path="alte_gui/frontend/src/workers/marketDataProcessor.worker.ts">
/**
 * Web Worker for Market Data Processing
 * Parallel processing for heavy calculations (SMA, EMA, RSI)
 * Performance: 5-10ms → 0.5ms (Background processing)
 */

interface WorkerMessage {
  type: 'PROCESS_MARKET_DATA' | 'CALCULATE_INDICATORS' | 'BATCH_PROCESS';
  data: any;
  symbol: string;
  id?: string;
}

interface MarketDataInput {
  prices: number[];
  volumes: number[];
  timestamps: number[];
}

interface ProcessedIndicators {
  sma20: number;
  sma50: number;
  ema12: number;
  ema26: number;
  rsi: number;
  macd: {
    macd: number;
    signal: number;
    histogram: number;
  };
  bollingerBands: {
    upper: number;
    middle: number;
    lower: number;
  };
}

// Worker-Context
self.onmessage = (event: MessageEvent<WorkerMessage>) => {
  const { type, data, symbol, id } = event.data;
  
  try {
    const startTime = performance.now();
    
    switch (type) {
      case 'PROCESS_MARKET_DATA':
        const processedData = processMarketData(data);
        self.postMessage({
          type: 'MARKET_DATA_PROCESSED',
          symbol,
          id,
          data: processedData,
          processingTime: performance.now() - startTime
        });
        break;
        
      case 'CALCULATE_INDICATORS':
        const indicators = calculateIndicators(data);
        self.postMessage({
          type: 'INDICATORS_CALCULATED',
          symbol,
          id,
          data: indicators,
          processingTime: performance.now() - startTime
        });
        break;
        
      case 'BATCH_PROCESS':
        const batchResults = processBatch(data);
        self.postMessage({
          type: 'BATCH_PROCESSED',
          symbol,
          id,
          data: batchResults,
          processingTime: performance.now() - startTime
        });
        break;
        
      default:
        console.warn('Unknown message type:', type);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    self.postMessage({
      type: 'ERROR',
      symbol,
      id,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Komplexe Berechnungen im Background Thread
 */
function processMarketData(data: MarketDataInput): ProcessedIndicators {
  const { prices, volumes } = data;
  
  if (!prices || prices.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('No price data provided');
  }

  // Parallel calculation of multiple indicators
  const sma20 = calculateSMA(prices, 20);
  const sma50 = calculateSMA(prices, 50);
  const ema12 = calculateEMA(prices, 12);
  const ema26 = calculateEMA(prices, 26);
  const rsi = calculateRSI(prices, 14);
  const macd = calculateMACD(prices, 12, 26, 9);
  const bollingerBands = calculateBollingerBands(prices, 20, 2);

  return {
    sma20,
    sma50,
    ema12,
    ema26,
    rsi,
    macd,
    bollingerBands
  };
}

/**
 * Calculate Simple Moving Average
 */
function calculateSMA(prices: number[], period: number): number {
  if (prices.length === 0) return 0;
  if (prices.length < period) return prices[prices.length - 1] ?? 0;
  
  const slice = prices.slice(-period);
  return slice.reduce((sum, price) => sum + price, 0) / slice.length;
}

/**
 * Calculate Exponential Moving Average
 */
function calculateEMA(prices: number[], period: number): number {
  if (prices.length === 0) return 0;
  if (prices.length === 1) return prices[0] ?? 0;
  
  const k = 2 / (period + 1);
  let ema = prices[0] ?? 0;
  
  for (let i = 1; i < prices.length; i++) {
    const currentPrice = prices[i] ?? 0;
    ema = currentPrice * k + ema * (1 - k);
  }
  
  return ema;
}

/**
 * Calculate Relative Strength Index
 */
function calculateRSI(prices: number[], period: number = 14): number {
  if (prices.length < period + 1) return 50; // Neutral RSI
  
  let gains = 0;
  let losses = 0;
  
  // Calculate initial average gain/loss
  for (let i = 1; i <= period; i++) {
    const currentPrice = prices[i] ?? 0;
    const previousPrice = prices[i - 1] ?? 0;
    const change = currentPrice - previousPrice;
    if (change > 0) {
      gains += change;
    } else {
      losses += Math.abs(change);
    }
  }
  
  let avgGain = gains / period;
  let avgLoss = losses / period;
  
  // Calculate RSI for remaining periods
  for (let i = period + 1; i < prices.length; i++) {
    const currentPrice = prices[i] ?? 0;
    const previousPrice = prices[i - 1] ?? 0;
    const change = currentPrice - previousPrice;
    const gain = change > 0 ? change : 0;
    const loss = change < 0 ? Math.abs(change) : 0;
    
    avgGain = (avgGain * (period - 1) + gain) / period;
    avgLoss = (avgLoss * (period - 1) + loss) / period;
  }
  
  if (avgLoss === 0) return 100;
  
  const rs = avgGain / avgLoss;
  return 100 - (100 / (1 + rs));
}

/**
 * Calculate MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence)
 */
function calculateMACD(prices: number[], fastPeriod: number = 12, slowPeriod: number = 26, signalPeriod: number = 9) {
  const emaFast = calculateEMA(prices, fastPeriod);
  const emaSlow = calculateEMA(prices, slowPeriod);
  const macdLine = emaFast - emaSlow;
  
  // For simplicity, using current MACD as signal (in reality, signal is EMA of MACD)
  const signal = macdLine * 0.9; // Simplified signal line
  const histogram = macdLine - signal;
  
  return {
    macd: macdLine,
    signal,
    histogram
  };
}

/**
 * Calculate Bollinger Bands
 */
function calculateBollingerBands(prices: number[], period: number = 20, stdDev: number = 2) {
  const sma = calculateSMA(prices, period);
  
  if (prices.length < period) {
    return {
      upper: sma,
      middle: sma,
      lower: sma
    };
  }
  
  const slice = prices.slice(-period);
  const variance = slice.reduce((sum, price) => sum + Math.pow(price - sma, 2), 0) / period;
  const standardDeviation = Math.sqrt(variance);
  
  return {
    upper: sma + (standardDeviation * stdDev),
    middle: sma,
    lower: sma - (standardDeviation * stdDev)
  };
}

/**
 * Individual indicator calculation
 */
function calculateIndicators(data: { type: string; prices: number[]; period?: number }) {
  const { type, prices, period = 20 } = data;
  
  switch (type) {
    case 'sma':
      return calculateSMA(prices, period);
    case 'ema':
      return calculateEMA(prices, period);
    case 'rsi':
      return calculateRSI(prices, period);
    case 'macd':
      return calculateMACD(prices);
    case 'bollinger':
      return calculateBollingerBands(prices, period);
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unknown indicator type: ${type}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Batch processing for multiple symbols
 */
function processBatch(batchData: Array<{ symbol: string; prices: number[]; volumes?: number[] }>) {
  return batchData.map(({ symbol, prices, volumes = [] }) => ({
    symbol,
    indicators: processMarketData({ prices, volumes, timestamps: [] })
  }));
}

// Performance monitoring
let processedMessages = 0;
let totalProcessingTime = 0;

self.addEventListener('message', () => {
  processedMessages++;
});

// Send performance stats every 10 seconds
setInterval(() => {
  if (processedMessages > 0) {
    self.postMessage({
      type: 'PERFORMANCE_STATS',
      data: {
        processedMessages,
        averageProcessingTime: totalProcessingTime / processedMessages,
        messagesPerSecond: processedMessages / 10
      }
    });
    
    // Reset counters
    processedMessages = 0;
    totalProcessingTime = 0;
  }
}, 10000);
</file>

<file path="alte_gui/frontend/src/workers/websocket-shared-worker.ts">
/// <reference lib="webworker" />

/**
 * SHARED WORKER für Cross-Tab WebSocket-Support
 * Ermöglicht WebSocket-Sharing zwischen mehreren Browser-Tabs
 */

interface SharedWorkerMessage {
  type: 'INIT' | 'SYMBOLS_REQUEST' | 'SYMBOLS_RESPONSE' | 'TICKER_UPDATE' | 'STATUS_REQUEST' | 'STATUS_RESPONSE';
  exchange?: string;
  data?: any;
  tabId?: string;
}

class WebSocketSharedWorker {
  private connections: Map<string, WebSocket> = new Map();
  private cache: Map<string, any> = new Map();
  private tabs: Set<MessagePort> = new Set();
  private tabIds: Map<MessagePort, string> = new Map();

  constructor() {
    console.log('🚀 WebSocket SharedWorker initialized');
  }

  // ✅ Tab-Registrierung
  registerTab(port: MessagePort, tabId: string) {
    this.tabs.add(port);
    this.tabIds.set(port, tabId);
    console.log(`📱 Tab registered: ${tabId} (Total: ${this.tabs.size})`);

    port.onmessage = (event) => {
      this.handleTabMessage(port, event.data);
    };

    port.onmessageerror = (error) => {
      console.error('SharedWorker message error:', error);
    };

    // Cleanup bei Tab-Schließung
    port.addEventListener('close', () => {
      this.unregisterTab(port);
    });
  }

  // ✅ Tab-Deregistrierung
  unregisterTab(port: MessagePort) {
    const tabId = this.tabIds.get(port);
    this.tabs.delete(port);
    this.tabIds.delete(port);
    console.log(`📱 Tab unregistered: ${tabId} (Remaining: ${this.tabs.size})`);
  }

  // ✅ Message-Handling
  handleTabMessage(sender: MessagePort, message: SharedWorkerMessage) {
    switch (message.type) {
      case 'INIT':
        this.handleInit(sender, message);
        break;
      case 'SYMBOLS_REQUEST':
        this.handleSymbolsRequest(sender, message);
        break;
      case 'STATUS_REQUEST':
        this.handleStatusRequest(sender);
        break;
    }
  }

  // ✅ Tab-Initialisierung
  handleInit(sender: MessagePort, message: SharedWorkerMessage) {
    // Bestehende Cache-Daten an neuen Tab senden
    this.cache.forEach((data, exchange) => {
      sender.postMessage({
        type: 'SYMBOLS_RESPONSE',
        exchange: exchange,
        data: data
      });
    });
  }

  // ✅ Symbol-Anfrage verarbeiten
  async handleSymbolsRequest(sender: MessagePort, message: SharedWorkerMessage) {
    const exchange = message.exchange!;
    
    // Cache-Hit
    if (this.cache.has(exchange)) {
      sender.postMessage({
        type: 'SYMBOLS_RESPONSE',
        exchange: exchange,
        data: this.cache.get(exchange)
      });
      return;
    }

    // WebSocket-Verbindung für Exchange sicherstellen
    await this.ensureWebSocketConnection(exchange);
  }

  // ✅ WebSocket-Verbindung verwalten
  async ensureWebSocketConnection(exchange: string) {
    if (this.connections.has(exchange)) {
      const ws = this.connections.get(exchange)!;
      if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
        return;
      }
    }

    // Neue WebSocket-Verbindung
    const wsUrl = `ws://localhost:8100/ws/symbols/${exchange}`;
    const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);

    ws.onopen = () => {
      console.log(`✅ SharedWorker WebSocket connected: ${exchange}`);
      this.connections.set(exchange, ws);
    };

    ws.onmessage = (event) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
      this.handleWebSocketMessage(exchange, data);
    };

    ws.onclose = () => {
      console.log(`🔌 SharedWorker WebSocket closed: ${exchange}`);
      this.connections.delete(exchange);
    };

    ws.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error(`❌ SharedWorker WebSocket error: ${exchange}`, error);
    };
  }

  // ✅ WebSocket-Message verarbeiten
  handleWebSocketMessage(exchange: string, data: any) {
    if (data.type === 'symbols_initial') {
      // Cache aktualisieren
      this.cache.set(exchange, data);
      
      // An alle Tabs broadcaaten
      this.broadcastToAllTabs({
        type: 'SYMBOLS_RESPONSE',
        exchange: exchange,
        data: data
      });
    } else if (data.type === 'ticker_update') {
      // Live-Updates an alle Tabs
      this.broadcastToAllTabs({
        type: 'TICKER_UPDATE',
        exchange: exchange,
        data: data
      });
    }
  }

  // ✅ Status-Anfrage
  handleStatusRequest(sender: MessagePort) {
    const status = {
      connections: Array.from(this.connections.keys()),
      cacheSize: this.cache.size,
      activeTabs: this.tabs.size
    };

    sender.postMessage({
      type: 'STATUS_RESPONSE',
      data: status
    });
  }

  // ✅ Broadcast an alle Tabs
  broadcastToAllTabs(message: any) {
    this.tabs.forEach(port => {
      try {
        port.postMessage(message);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to send message to tab:', error);
      }
    });
  }
}

// ✅ SharedWorker-Instance
const sharedWorker = new WebSocketSharedWorker();

// ✅ Verbindungs-Handler
self.addEventListener('connect', (event) => {
  const port = (event as any).ports[0];
  const tabId = `tab_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;
  
  sharedWorker.registerTab(port, tabId);
  port.start();
});
</file>

<file path="alte_gui/frontend/src/App.tsx">
import { QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Suspense, lazy } from "react";
import { AppLayout } from "./shared/layout/AppLayout";
import ThemeProvider from "./shared/ui/theme-provider";
import { TradingProvider } from "./contexts/TradingContext";
import { queryClient } from "./lib/react-query";

// 🚀 LANE SYSTEM - SETTINGS PROVIDER
import { SettingsProvider } from "./shared/state/SettingsProvider";

// ✅ Code-Splitting: Pages lazy laden
const TradingPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/TradingPage"));
const QuantumPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/QuantumPage"));
const BotPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/BotPage"));
const MLPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/MLPage"));
const DatabasePage = lazy(() => import("./pages/DatabasePage"));
const WhalesPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/WhalesPage"));
const NewsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/NewsPage"));
const APIPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/APIPage"));
const SettingsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/SettingsPage"));

// ✅ Logs Feature
const LogsPage = lazy(() => import("./features/logs").then(m => ({ default: m.LogsPage })));
const DiagnosticsPage = lazy(() => import("./features/logs").then(m => ({ default: m.DiagnosticsPage })));

// Loading Fallback Component
const PageLoader = () => (
  <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-screen">
    <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
  </div>
);

// 🚀 LANE SYSTEM - SIMPLIFIED APP WITH SETTINGS PROVIDER
const App = () => (
  <ThemeProvider>
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <TradingProvider>
        <SettingsProvider>
          <BrowserRouter>
            <Suspense fallback={<PageLoader />}>
              <Routes>
                <Route path="/" element={<AppLayout />}>
                  <Route index element={<Navigate to="/trading" replace />} />
                  <Route path="trading" element={<TradingPage />} />
                  <Route path="quantum" element={<QuantumPage />} />
                  <Route path="bot" element={<BotPage />} />
                  <Route path="ml" element={<MLPage />} />
                  <Route path="database" element={<DatabasePage />} />
                  <Route path="whales" element={<WhalesPage />} />
                  <Route path="news" element={<NewsPage />} />
                  <Route path="api" element={<APIPage />} />
                  <Route path="settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
                  <Route path="diagnostics" element={<DiagnosticsPage />} />
                  <Route path="logs/:exchange" element={<LogsPage />} />
                </Route>
              </Routes>
            </Suspense>
          </BrowserRouter>
        </SettingsProvider>
      </TradingProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  </ThemeProvider>
);

export default App;

<file path="alte_gui/frontend/src/main.tsx">
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import App from "./App.tsx";
import "./index.css";

// Error Handling
import { ErrorBoundary } from "./shared/error/ErrorBoundary";

// Event-System initialisieren
import { bootstrapEvents } from "./shared/events/bootstrap";
import { SettingsProvider } from "./shared/state/SettingsProvider";

// ✅ Exchange & Market-Type Config laden (Single Source of Truth: backend/.env)
import { loadExchangeConfig, loadMarketTypeConfig } from "./services/config";

bootstrapEvents();

// ✅ App-Initialization: Lade Exchange-Config bevor React rendert
async function initializeApp() {
  console.log('🚀 Initializing DarkMa Trading System...');
  
  try {
    // Lade Exchange-Liste und Market-Types vom Backend (parallel, cached)
    const [exchangeConfig, marketTypeConfig] = await Promise.all([
      loadExchangeConfig(),
      loadMarketTypeConfig()
    ]);
    console.log(`✅ System ready: ${exchangeConfig.count} exchanges, ${marketTypeConfig.count} market types available`);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('⚠️ Config initialization failed (using fallback):', error);
  }
  
  // Render React App
  createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <SettingsProvider>
        <App />
      </SettingsProvider>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

// Start App
initializeApp();
</file>

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Trading Page - E2E Smoke Tests
 * ✅ VERBESSERT: Prüft Browser Console Errors!
 */

test.describe('Trading Page - Critical Tests', () => {
  
  test('GUI lädt ohne 500 Error', async ({ page }) => {
    const response = await page.goto('/trading');
    expect(response?.status()).toBe(200);
  });

  test('Keine Console Errors beim Laden', async ({ page }) => {
    const consoleErrors: string[] = [];
    
    // ✅ KRITISCH: Fange Console Errors ab!
    page.on('console', msg => {
      if (msg.type() === 'error') {
        const text = msg.text();
        
        // Ignoriere Test-bedingte Errors:
        if (
          text.includes('503') || 
          text.includes('Service Unavailable') ||
          text.includes('ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES') ||
          text.includes('Failed to fetch')
        ) {
          return; // Timing/Ressourcen-Probleme während Test
        }
        
        consoleErrors.push(text);
      }
    });
    
    // ✅ KRITISCH: Fange Page Errors ab (z.B. Import-Errors)!
    page.on('pageerror', error => {
      consoleErrors.push(error.message);
    });
    
    // Lade Page
    await page.goto('/trading', { timeout: 30000 });
    await page.waitForTimeout(8000); // Warte 8s für Backend & Initialisierung
    
    // Prüfe: KEINE Console Errors (außer 503 während Start)!
    if (consoleErrors.length > 0) {
      console.log('❌ Console Errors gefunden:');
      consoleErrors.forEach(err => console.log('  -', err));
      throw new Error(`Console Errors detected: ${consoleErrors.join(' | ')}`);
    }
  });

  test('Kein Error Boundary sichtbar', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/trading');
    await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
    
    // ✅ Prüfe ob Error Boundary angezeigt wird
    const errorBoundary = page.locator('text=/Error|Something went wrong/i');
    await expect(errorBoundary).not.toBeVisible();
  });

});

test.describe('Trading Page - Optional Tests', () => {
  
  test('Chart Container existiert', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/trading');
    await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
    
    const container = page.locator('div').first();
    await expect(container).toBeVisible();
  });

});
</file>

class HMRContext {
  constructor(hmrClient, ownerPath) {
    this.hmrClient = hmrClient;
    this.ownerPath = ownerPath;
    if (!hmrClient.dataMap.has(ownerPath)) {
      hmrClient.dataMap.set(ownerPath, {});
    }
    const mod = hmrClient.hotModulesMap.get(ownerPath);
    if (mod) {
      mod.callbacks = [];
    }
    const staleListeners = hmrClient.ctxToListenersMap.get(ownerPath);
    if (staleListeners) {
      for (const [event, staleFns] of staleListeners) {
        const listeners = hmrClient.customListenersMap.get(event);
        if (listeners) {
          hmrClient.customListenersMap.set(
            event,
            listeners.filter((l) => !staleFns.includes(l))
          );
        }
      }
    }
    this.newListeners = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    hmrClient.ctxToListenersMap.set(ownerPath, this.newListeners);
  }
  get data() {
    return this.hmrClient.dataMap.get(this.ownerPath);
  }
  accept(deps, callback) {
    if (typeof deps === "function" || !deps) {
      this.acceptDeps([this.ownerPath], ([mod]) => deps?.(mod));
    } else if (typeof deps === "string") {
      this.acceptDeps([deps], ([mod]) => callback?.(mod));
    } else if (Array.isArray(deps)) {
      this.acceptDeps(deps, callback);
    } else {
      throw new Error(`invalid hot.accept() usage.`);

  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",

<file path="alte_gui/frontend/index.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>Crypto GUI</title>
    
    <!-- Idle-Prefetch für Lightweight Charts (kein Initial-Load Blocking!) -->
    <link rel="prefetch" href="/lightweight-charts.standalone.development.js" as="script">
    <link rel="prefetch" href="/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js" as="script">
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root"></div>
    <!-- Chart wird nun via chartLazyLoader.ts on-demand geladen -->
    <!-- Vite/React laden -->
    <script type="module" src="/src/main.tsx"></script>
  </body>
</html>
</file>

<file path="alte_gui/frontend/playwright.config.ts">
import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test';

/**
 * Playwright Configuration für Smoke Tests
 * https://playwright.dev/docs/test-configuration
 */
export default defineConfig({
  testDir: './tests',
  
  // Smoke Tests sollten schnell sein
  timeout: 10 * 1000, // 10s max per test
  
  // Parallel ausführen für Geschwindigkeit
  fullyParallel: true,
  
  // Keine Retries bei Smoke Tests (fail-fast!)
  retries: 0,
  
  // Reporter
  reporter: 'line',
  
  // Shared settings
  use: {
    // Base URL für Tests
    baseURL: 'http://localhost:8080',
    
    // Browser Context Options
    viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 },
    
    // Collect trace nur bei Failure
    trace: 'retain-on-failure',
    
    // Screenshot nur bei Failure
    screenshot: 'only-on-failure',
  },
  
  // Configure projects für verschiedene Browser
  projects: [
    {
      name: 'chromium',
      use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'] },
    },
  ],
  
  // Dev Server starten (optional, wenn noch nicht läuft)
  // webServer: {
  //   command: 'npm run dev',
  //   url: 'http://localhost:8080',
  //   reuseExistingServer: true,
  //   timeout: 120 * 1000,
  // },
});
</file>

<file path="backend/ai/shared/ai_config.py">
# backend/ai/shared/ai_config.py
"""
AI Domain Configuration - Extrahiert aus core/config.py
✅ Clean Domain-Architektur: AI-spezifische Configs in ai/shared/
✅ YAML-basiert: Lädt tier1, tier2, tier3, ai_config, telegram configs
✅ Singleton Pattern: Einmalige Initialisierung für das AI System
"""

import os
from typing import Dict, Any
import yaml
from pathlib import Path
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class AIConfig:
    """
    AI Domain Configuration Manager
    ✅ Lädt und verwaltet alle AI-spezifischen Konfigurationen
    ✅ Singleton Pattern für konsistente AI-Konfiguration
    ✅ YAML-basierte Konfiguration für AI Tiers und Services
    """
    
    _instance = None
    
    def __new__(cls):
        if cls._instance is None:
            cls._instance = super(AIConfig, cls).__new__(cls)
            cls._instance._load_ai_config()
        return cls._instance
    
    def _load_ai_config(self):
        """Lädt alle AI-spezifischen Konfigurationsdateien"""
        # Config path - relativ zur Datei (CWD-unabhängig)
        config_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "config"  # R2.1: CWD-unabhängig
        
        # ===== AI TIER KONFIGURATIONEN =====
        self.tier1_config = self._load_yaml(config_path / "tier1_config.yaml")
        self.tier2_config = self._load_yaml(config_path / "tier2_config.yaml") 
        self.tier3_config = self._load_yaml(config_path / "tier3_config.yaml")
        
        # ===== AI SYSTEM KONFIGURATION =====
        self.ai_config = self._load_yaml(config_path / "ai_config.yaml")
        
        # ===== AI COMMUNICATION KONFIGURATION =====
        self.telegram_config = self._load_yaml(config_path / "telegram_config.yaml")
        
        # ===== AI MODEL SERVICES =====
        # Ollama für lokale AI Models
        self.ollama_base_url = os.getenv("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "http://localhost:11434")
        
        # OpenAI/Anthropic für externe AI Models (falls konfiguriert)
        self.openai_api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "")
        self.anthropic_api_key = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "")
        
        # ===== AI FEATURE FLAGS =====
        self.chart_analysis_enabled = self._get_ai_feature_flag("charts", "enabled", False)
        self.natural_language_enabled = self._get_ai_feature_flag("natural_language", "enabled", False)
        self.telegram_bot_enabled = self._get_ai_feature_flag("telegram", "enabled", False)
        
        # ===== AI PERFORMANCE SETTINGS =====
        self.ai_request_timeout = int(os.getenv("AI_REQUEST_TIMEOUT", "30"))  # seconds
        self.ai_max_retries = int(os.getenv("AI_MAX_RETRIES", "3"))
        self.ai_concurrent_requests = int(os.getenv("AI_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS", "5"))
        
        logger.info("AI Config initialized successfully")
    
    def _load_yaml(self, file_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Lädt eine YAML Konfigurationsdatei"""
        if file_path.exists():
            try:
                with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    return yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Failed to load {file_path}: {str(e)}")
                return {}
        else:
            logger.warning(f"Config file not found: {file_path}")
            return {}
    
    def _get_ai_feature_flag(self, service: str, flag: str, default: bool = False) -> bool:
        """Extrahiert Feature Flag aus AI Config"""
        try:
            return self.ai_config.get(service, {}).get(flag, default)
        except Exception:
            return default
    
    # ===== PUBLIC API METHODS =====
    
    def get_tier_config(self, tier: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Gibt die Konfiguration für ein bestimmtes AI Tier zurück"""
        if tier == 1:
            return self.tier1_config
        elif tier == 2:
            return self.tier2_config
        elif tier == 3:
            return self.tier3_config
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Ungültiges AI Tier: {tier}. Gültig: 1, 2, 3")
    
    def get_ai_config(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Gibt die AI System Konfiguration zurück"""
        return self.ai_config or self._get_default_ai_config()
    
    def get_telegram_config(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Gibt die Telegram Bot Konfiguration zurück"""
        return self.telegram_config
    
    def get_model_config(self, model_provider: str = "ollama") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Gibt Model-spezifische Konfiguration zurück
        
        Args:
            model_provider: "ollama", "openai", "anthropic"
        """
        if model_provider == "ollama":
            return {
                "base_url": self.ollama_base_url,
                "timeout": self.ai_request_timeout,
                "max_retries": self.ai_max_retries
            }
        elif model_provider == "openai":
            return {
                "api_key": self.openai_api_key,
                "timeout": self.ai_request_timeout,
                "max_retries": self.ai_max_retries
            }
        elif model_provider == "anthropic":
            return {
                "api_key": self.anthropic_api_key,
                "timeout": self.ai_request_timeout,
                "max_retries": self.ai_max_retries
            }
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown model provider: {model_provider}")
    
    def is_feature_enabled(self, feature: str) -> bool:
        """
        Prüft ob ein AI Feature aktiviert ist
        
        Args:
            feature: "charts", "natural_language", "telegram"
        """
        feature_map = {
            "charts": self.chart_analysis_enabled,
            "natural_language": self.natural_language_enabled,
            "telegram": self.telegram_bot_enabled
        }
        
        return feature_map.get(feature, False)
    
    def get_performance_config(self) -> Dict[str, int]:
        """Gibt AI Performance Konfiguration zurück"""
        return {
            "request_timeout": self.ai_request_timeout,
            "max_retries": self.ai_max_retries,
            "concurrent_requests": self.ai_concurrent_requests
        }
    
    def _get_default_ai_config(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Gibt eine Standard-AI-Konfiguration zurück, wenn die Datei fehlt."""
        logger.warning("Using default AI config as ai_config.yaml was not found.")
        return {
            "version": "1.0-default",
            "charts": {"enabled": False},
            "natural_language": {"enabled": False},
            "telegram": {"enabled": False}
        }
    
    # ===== SYSTEM INTEGRATION METHODS =====
    
    def get_all_tier_configs(self) -> Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Gibt alle Tier-Konfigurationen zurück"""
        return {
            1: self.tier1_config,
            2: self.tier2_config,
            3: self.tier3_config
        }
    
    def validate_config(self) -> Dict[str, bool]:
        """Validiert alle AI-Konfigurationen und gibt Status zurück"""
        validation_results = {
            "tier1_loaded": bool(self.tier1_config),
            "tier2_loaded": bool(self.tier2_config),
            "tier3_loaded": bool(self.tier3_config),
            "ai_config_loaded": bool(self.ai_config),
            "telegram_config_loaded": bool(self.telegram_config),
            "ollama_configured": bool(self.ollama_base_url),
            "any_features_enabled": any([
                self.chart_analysis_enabled,
                self.natural_language_enabled,
                self.telegram_bot_enabled
            ])
        }
        
        validation_results["overall_valid"] = all([
            validation_results["ai_config_loaded"],
            validation_results["any_features_enabled"]
        ])
        
        return validation_results


# ===== GLOBAL AI CONFIG INSTANCE =====
# Für einfache Verwendung im AI System
try:
    ai_config = AIConfig()
    logger.info("✅ AI Config instance created successfully")
except Exception as e:
    logger.critical(f"FATAL: Could not initialize AIConfig. Error: {e}")
    
    # Fallback to minimal AI config to prevent system crashes
    class MinimalAIConfig:
        def __init__(self):
            self.tier1_config = {}
            self.tier2_config = {}
            self.tier3_config = {}
            self.ai_config = {}
            self.telegram_config = {}
            self.ollama_base_url = "http://localhost:11434"
            self.openai_api_key = ""
            self.anthropic_api_key = ""
            self.chart_analysis_enabled = False
            self.natural_language_enabled = False
            self.telegram_bot_enabled = False
            self.ai_request_timeout = 30
            self.ai_max_retries = 3
            self.ai_concurrent_requests = 5
        
        def get_tier_config(self, tier: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            return {}
        
        def get_ai_config(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            return {"version": "minimal-fallback"}
        
        def is_feature_enabled(self, feature: str) -> bool:
            return False
            
    ai_config = MinimalAIConfig()
    logger.warning("Using minimal AI config due to initialization failure")


# ===== CONVENIENCE FUNCTIONS =====
def get_ai_config() -> AIConfig:
    """Gibt die globale AI Config Instanz zurück"""
    return ai_config

def get_tier_config(tier: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Convenience function für Tier Config"""
    return ai_config.get_tier_config(tier)

def is_ai_feature_enabled(feature: str) -> bool:
    """Convenience function für Feature Flags"""
    return ai_config.is_feature_enabled(feature)

def get_ollama_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Convenience function für Ollama Config"""
    return ai_config.get_model_config("ollama")
</file>

<file path="backend/api/routers/ro_market_data.py">
"""
ro_market_data.py – Unified Market Data Router

Dieses Modul fasst die Funktionalität der bisherigen Router

- market.py
- unified_trades_api.py
- unified_orderbook.py
- unified_symbols.py
- ticker.py
- enterprise_market_proxy.py

zu einem generischen, exchange-agnostischen Market-Data-Layer zusammen.

Kerneigenschaften:
- Einheitliche Endpoints für Orderbook, Trades, Ticker und Symbols
- Exchange-Auto-Discovery über ExchangeFactory (keine Hardcodings)
- Symbol-Resolution über SYMBOL_REGISTRY + asset_key (Coin-Mapper)
- Exakte Decimal-Verarbeitung (Spread, Volumen) mit JSON-sicherer Serialisierung
- Keine Mock-Daten, alle Aufrufe gehen direkt auf die realen REST-APIs
- Legacy-kompatible Kurz-Endpoints (z. B. /binance/trades/spot, /ticker/legacy) für bestehende Clients

Dieses Modul dient als zentrale, konsolidierte Market-API für das gesamte System
und wird vom Enterprise-Gateway (enterprise_market_proxy.py) als Datenquelle verwendet.
"""

import logging
import json
import time
import os
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, Depends, Path
from fastapi.responses import Response

from backend.services.adapter.exchange_factory import ExchangeFactory
from backend.api.dependencies.client import get_client_id
from backend.api.models.keys import Market, asset_key
from backend.services.domain.unified_symbol_registry import SYMBOL_REGISTRY

logger = logging.getLogger("ro-market-data")

market_router = APIRouter()

# =========================
# JSON / DECIMAL HANDLING
# =========================


class DecimalEncoder(json.JSONEncoder):
    """Custom JSON encoder for Decimal support."""
    def default(self, obj: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(obj, Decimal):
            return str(obj)
        return super().default(obj)


def dumps_with_decimals(obj: Any) -> str:
    """JSON-dump with Decimal support and compact separators."""
    return json.dumps(obj, cls=DecimalEncoder, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))


def json_response_with_decimals(content: Dict[str, Any], headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> Response:
    """FastAPI Response mit Decimal-safe JSON body."""
    json_content = dumps_with_decimals(content)
    return Response(
        content=json_content,
        media_type="application/json",
        headers=headers or {},
    )


# =========================
# HELPER: DEFAULT EXCHANGE
# =========================


def get_default_exchange() -> str:
    """
    Liefert die erste verfügbare Exchange aus der Factory.
    Fallback auf .env DEFAULT_EXCHANGE oder erste aus ENABLED_EXCHANGES.
    """
    try:
        available = ExchangeFactory.get_available_exchanges()
        if available:
            return available[0]
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to determine default exchange from ExchangeFactory: {e}", exc_info=True)

    # Fallback auf .env
    default = os.getenv("DEFAULT_EXCHANGE", "")
    if default:
        logger.info(f"✅ Using DEFAULT_EXCHANGE from .env: {default}")
        return default.strip().lower()
    
    # Letzter Fallback: Erste aus ENABLED_EXCHANGES
    enabled = [e.strip().lower() for e in os.getenv("ENABLED_EXCHANGES", "binance").split(",") if e.strip()]
    result = enabled[0] if enabled else "binance"
    logger.warning(f"Using fallback exchange: {result}")
    return result


# =========================
# SYMBOL RESOLUTION
# =========================


async def validate_symbol(
    symbol: str,
    market_type: str,
    exchange: Optional[str] = None,
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """
    Validiert Symbol mit asset_key Mapping (Coin Mapper + SYMBOL_REGISTRY).

    Rückgabe:
        (selected_exchange, native_symbol_for_exchange)
    """
    try:
        input_symbol = symbol.upper()
        mt = market_type.lower().strip()
        market_enum = Market.SPOT if mt == "spot" else Market.FUTURES

        # Helper: parse base/quote für asset_key
        def _parse_base_quote(sym: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
            s = sym.upper()
            if "USDT" in s:
                return s.replace("USDT", ""), "USDT"
            if "USDC" in s:
                return s.replace("USDC", ""), "USDC"
            if "USD" in s and "USDT" not in s and "USDC" not in s:
                return s.replace("USD", ""), "USD"
            # Fallback-Heuristik
            return s[:3], s[3:]

        # 1) Fester Exchange vorgegeben
        if exchange:
            ex = exchange.lower()
            try:
                catalog = await SYMBOL_REGISTRY.catalog(ex, market_enum)
            except Exception as reg_err:
                logger.warning(f"Symbol registry error for {ex}: {reg_err}")
                # Fallback: trotzdem versuchen
                return ex, input_symbol

            # Direkter native_symbol Match
            direct = next((x for x in catalog if x.get("native_symbol") == input_symbol), None)
            if direct:
                return ex, input_symbol

            # asset_key Match
            try:
                base, quote = _parse_base_quote(input_symbol)
                target_key = asset_key(base, quote)
                match = next((x for x in catalog if x.get("asset_key") == target_key), None)
                if match:
                    native = match["native_symbol"]
                    logger.info(f"✅ Coin Mapper: {input_symbol} → {native} on {ex} (asset_key={target_key})")
                    return ex, native
            except Exception as parse_err:
                logger.debug(f"Asset key parsing failed for {input_symbol} on {ex}: {parse_err}")

            logger.warning(f"⚠️ Symbol {symbol} not found in registry for {ex}, using raw symbol")
            return ex, input_symbol

        # 2) Auto-Detection über alle Exchanges (Factory-basiert, keine harte Liste)
        try:
            all_exchanges = ExchangeFactory.get_available_exchanges() or []
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to get available exchanges from ExchangeFactory: {e}", exc_info=True)
            all_exchanges = []

        for ex in all_exchanges:
            ex_lower = ex.lower()
            try:
                catalog = await SYMBOL_REGISTRY.catalog(ex_lower, market_enum)
            except Exception as reg_err:
                logger.debug(f"Failed to fetch catalog for {ex_lower}: {reg_err}")
                continue

            # Direkter native_symbol Match
            direct = next((x for x in catalog if x.get("native_symbol") == input_symbol), None)
            if direct:
                logger.info(f"✅ Direct symbol match: {input_symbol} on {ex_lower}")
                return ex_lower, input_symbol

            # asset_key Match
            try:
                base, quote = _parse_base_quote(input_symbol)
                target_key = asset_key(base, quote)
                match = next((x for x in catalog if x.get("asset_key") == target_key), None)
                if match:
                    native = match["native_symbol"]
                    logger.info(f"✅ Coin Mapper: {input_symbol} → {native} on {ex_lower} (asset_key={target_key})")
                    return ex_lower, native
            except Exception:
                continue

        # 3) Fallback-Heuristik wie bisher (BTC/ETH → Binance; Rest → Default-Exchange)
        try:
            default_ex = get_default_exchange()
        except Exception:
            default_ex = "bitget"

        if input_symbol in {"BTCUSDT", "ETHUSDT", "BNBUSDT"}:
            fallback = "binance" if "binance" in (ExchangeFactory.get_available_exchanges() or []) else default_ex
        else:
            fallback = default_ex

        logger.warning(f"Using fallback exchange {fallback} for {input_symbol}")
        return fallback, input_symbol

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Symbol validation failed for {symbol}: {e}", exc_info=True)
        try:
            default_ex = get_default_exchange()
        except Exception:
            default_ex = "bitget"
        return default_ex, symbol.upper()


# =========================
# ORDERBOOK HANDLING
# =========================


async def _fetch_orderbook_for_exchange(
    exchange: str,
    symbol: str,
    market_type: str,
    limit: int,
    user_id: Optional[str] = None,
    allow_fallback: bool = True,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Vereinheitlichte Orderbook-Funktion für ALLE Exchanges.
    - Nutzt ExchangeFactory REST-API
    - Enriched mit SYMBOL_REGISTRY (asset_key, instrument_uid)
    - Exakte Decimal-Arithmetik für Spread & Volumen
    - Optionaler Fallback: Binance Futures → Bitget Futures
    """
    ex = exchange.lower().strip()
    mt = market_type.lower().strip()

    api = ExchangeFactory.get_rest_api(ex, user_id=user_id)
    if not api:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=f"Orderbook API not available for {ex}")

    try:
        # Markt-spezifischer API-Call
        if mt == "spot":
            ob = await api.fetch_spot_orderbook(symbol, limit)
        elif mt in {"futures", "usdtm", "coinm", "perp"}:
            try:
                ob = await api.fetch_futures_orderbook(symbol, limit)
            except Exception as fut_err:
                # Binance-Fallback → Bitget, wie im Altcode
                if ex == "binance" and allow_fallback:
                    logger.warning(f"Binance futures failed for {symbol}, trying Bitget: {fut_err}")
                    return await _fetch_orderbook_for_exchange("bitget", symbol, mt, limit, user_id, allow_fallback=False)
                raise
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported market type: {market_type}")

        if not ob:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Orderbook not found for {symbol} on {ex}")

        ob["exchange"] = ex
        ob["source"] = "real_api"
        ob["market_type"] = mt
        ob["limit"] = limit
        ob["timestamp"] = int(time.time() * 1000)

        # Symbol-Metadaten aus Registry (asset_key, instrument_uid)
        try:
            m_enum = Market.SPOT if mt == "spot" else Market.FUTURES
            catalog = await SYMBOL_REGISTRY.catalog(ex, m_enum)
            meta = next((x for x in catalog if x.get("native_symbol") == symbol.upper()), None)
            if meta:
                ob["asset_key"] = meta.get("asset_key")
                ob["instrument_uid"] = meta.get("instrument_uid")
        except Exception as meta_err:
            logger.debug(f"Could not enrich orderbook with metadata: {meta_err}")

        # Spread / Volumen berechnen – exakte Decimal-Arithmetik, Originalstrings beibehalten
        try:
            if ob.get("bids") and ob.get("asks"):
                best_bid_str = str(ob["bids"][0][0]) if ob["bids"] else "0"
                best_ask_str = str(ob["asks"][0][0]) if ob["asks"] else "0"

                if best_bid_str != "0" and best_ask_str != "0":
                    bb = Decimal(best_bid_str)
                    ba = Decimal(best_ask_str)
                    spread = ba - bb
                    spread_percent = (spread / ba * Decimal("100"))
                else:
                    spread = Decimal("0")
                    spread_percent = Decimal("0")

                try:
                    bid_volume = str(sum(Decimal(str(b[1])) for b in ob["bids"][:10]))
                    ask_volume = str(sum(Decimal(str(a[1])) for a in ob["asks"][:10]))
                except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
                    bid_volume = "0"
                    ask_volume = "0"

                ob.update(
                    {
                        "spread": str(spread),
                        "spread_percent": str(spread_percent),
                        "best_bid": best_bid_str,
                        "best_ask": best_ask_str,
                        "bid_volume_top10": bid_volume,
                        "ask_volume_top10": ask_volume,
                    }
                )
        except Exception as calc_err:
            logger.debug(f"Orderbook spread/volume calculation failed: {calc_err}")

        return ob

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Orderbook API failed for {ex}/{symbol} ({market_type}): {e}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"{ex} orderbook error: {str(e)}")


@market_router.get("/orderbook")
async def get_unified_orderbook(
    symbol: str = Query(..., description="Trading symbol, e.g. BTCUSDT"),
    market_type: str = Query("spot", description="Market type (spot|futures)"),
    limit: int = Query(15, ge=1, le=5000, description="Number of bids/asks to return"),
    exchange: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Optional explicit exchange override"),
    user_id: Optional[str] = Depends(get_client_id),
):
    """
    Unified OrderBook Endpoint – ersetzt alten unified_orderbook + market.orderbook.
    - Exchange Auto-Detection via SYMBOL_REGISTRY (wenn exchange nicht gesetzt)
    - Exakte Spread-/Volumenberechnung
    - Keine Mock-Daten, nur Live-API
    """
    try:
        selected_exchange, native_symbol = await validate_symbol(symbol, market_type, exchange)
        logger.info(f"🔄 Routing orderbook {symbol} → {selected_exchange}/{native_symbol} ({market_type})")

        result = await _fetch_orderbook_for_exchange(
            exchange=selected_exchange,
            symbol=native_symbol,
            market_type=market_type,
            limit=limit,
            user_id=user_id,
        )

        return json_response_with_decimals(
            content=result,
            headers={
                "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=3",
                "Vary": "Accept, Authorization",
            },
        )
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Unified orderbook failed for {symbol}: {e}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Orderbook routing error: {str(e)}")


@market_router.get("/orderbook/{exchange}/spot")
async def get_spot_orderbook_by_path(
    exchange: str,
    symbol: str = Query(..., description="Trading symbol, e.g. BTCUSDT"),
    limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=5000, description="Number of bids/asks to return"),
):
    """Spot OrderBook mit Path-Parametern – Frontend-kompatibel."""
    return await get_unified_orderbook(symbol=symbol, market_type="spot", limit=limit, exchange=exchange)


@market_router.get("/orderbook/{exchange}/futures")
async def get_futures_orderbook_by_path(
    exchange: str,
    symbol: str = Query(..., description="Trading symbol, e.g. BTCUSDT"),
    limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=5000, description="Number of bids/asks to return"),
):
    """Futures OrderBook mit Path-Parametern – Frontend-kompatibel."""
    return await get_unified_orderbook(symbol=symbol, market_type="futures", limit=limit, exchange=exchange)


@market_router.get("/orderbook/exchanges")
async def get_supported_orderbook_exchanges():
    """Liste aller unterstützten Exchanges für Orderbook-Daten (Factory-basiert, keine Hardcodierung)."""
    try:
        supported = ExchangeFactory.get_available_exchanges() or []
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to query available exchanges: {e}", exc_info=True)
        supported = []

    return {
        "supported_exchanges": supported,
        "auto_detection": True,
        "real_data_only": True,
        "unified_api": "/api/market/orderbook",
    }


# =========================
# TRADES HANDLING
# =========================


async def _get_exchange_trades(
    exchange: str,
    symbol: str,
    market: str,
    limit: int,
    user_id: Optional[str] = None,
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Gemeinsame Logik für alle Exchange-Trades (unified_trades_api).
    - Bevorzugt fetch_spot_trades / fetch_futures_trades
    - Fallback: fetch_trades
    - Setzt deterministische Felder exchange/market
    """
    try:
        api = ExchangeFactory.get_rest_api(exchange, user_id=user_id)
        if not api:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=f"Trade API not available for {exchange}")

        trades: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []

        m = (market or "spot").strip().lower()
        is_fut = m in {"futures", "usdtm", "coinm", "perp", "linear", "inverse"}

        if is_fut and hasattr(api, "fetch_futures_trades"):
            trades = await api.fetch_futures_trades(symbol, limit)
        elif not is_fut and hasattr(api, "fetch_spot_trades"):
            trades = await api.fetch_spot_trades(symbol, limit)
        elif hasattr(api, "fetch_trades"):
            trades = await api.fetch_trades(symbol, limit)
        else:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=f"No trade method on {exchange} REST API")

        for t in trades or []:
            t["exchange"] = exchange
            t["market"] = "futures" if is_fut else "spot"

        if trades:
            logger.info(f"✅ {exchange.upper()} {('futures' if is_fut else 'spot')} trades for {symbol}: {len(trades)}")
            return trades

        logger.warning(f"⚠️ Empty trades for {exchange}/{symbol} ({'futures' if is_fut else 'spot'})")
        return []

    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as api_error:
        logger.error(f"API trades failed for {exchange}/{symbol} ({market}): {api_error}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=503,
            detail=f"Trade service unavailable for {exchange}/{symbol} ({market})",
        )


@market_router.get("/trades")
async def get_trades_unified(
    exchange: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Exchange name (auto-discovery default if not set)"),
    symbol: str = Query("BTCUSDT"),
    market: str = Query("spot"),
    limit: int = Query(100, gt=0, le=1000),
    user_id: Optional[str] = Depends(get_client_id),
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Unified Trades Endpoint – ersetzt:
    - market.trades
    - unified_trades_api.get_trades_legacy
    """
    ex = exchange or get_default_exchange()
    return await _get_exchange_trades(ex, symbol, market, limit, user_id)


# Exchange-spezifische Kurz-Endpoints (kompatibel mit unified_trades_api)

# ✅ GENERISCHER TRADES-ENDPOINT - Ersetzt alle 16 hardcoded Endpoints
@market_router.get("/{exchange}/trades/{market}")
async def get_exchange_trades_generic(
    exchange: str,
    market: str = Path(..., regex="^(spot|futures|usdtm|coinm|margin)$"),
    symbol: str = Query("BTCUSDT"),
    limit: int = Query(100, gt=0, le=1000),
):
    """
    ✅ GENERISCH: Ein Endpoint für ALLE Exchanges/Markets
    Validiert gegen .env ENABLED_EXCHANGES
    
    Beispiele: 
      /api/market/binance/trades/spot
      /api/market/mexc/trades/futures
      /api/market/okx/trades/usdtm
    """
    # Validierung gegen .env ENABLED_EXCHANGES
    allowed_exchanges = [e.strip().lower() for e in os.getenv("ENABLED_EXCHANGES", "binance").split(",") if e.strip()]
    
    if exchange.lower() not in allowed_exchanges:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=404, 
            detail=f"Exchange '{exchange}' not enabled. Available: {allowed_exchanges}"
        )
    
    logger.info(f"📊 Generic trades endpoint: {exchange}/{market}/{symbol}")
    return await _get_exchange_trades(exchange, symbol, market, limit)


# =========================
# TICKER HANDLING
# =========================


@market_router.get("/ticker")
async def get_ticker(
    exchange: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Exchange name (binance|bitget|...)"),
    symbol: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Optional symbol filter, e.g. BTCUSDT"),
    market_type: str = Query("spot", description="Market type (spot|usdtm|usdcm|coinm|futures)"),
    user_id: Optional[str] = Depends(get_client_id),
):
    """
    Unified Market Ticker Endpoint – kombiniert Logik aus:
    - market.market_ticker
    - ticker.get_ticker
    Voll generisch, keine Bitget-Sonderfälle.
    """
    try:
        ex = exchange or get_default_exchange()

        if not ExchangeFactory.is_exchange_available(ex):
            available = ExchangeFactory.get_available_exchanges()
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Exchange '{ex}' not available. Available: {available}",
            )

        api = ExchangeFactory.get_rest_api(ex, user_id=user_id)
        if not api:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to initialize {ex} API")

        mt = market_type.lower().strip()

        # Mapping für Futures/Derivate wie im Altcode
        if mt == "spot":
            api_filter = "spot"
        elif mt in {"usdtm", "usdcm", "coinm", "futures"}:
            api_filter = "futures"
        else:
            api_filter = "spot"

        tickers = await api.fetch_tickers(market_filter=api_filter)

        # Bitget-spezifischer Produktfilter – nur anwenden, wenn es Bitget ist
        if ex == "bitget" and mt in {"usdtm", "usdcm", "coinm"}:
            product_type_map = {
                "usdtm": "USDT-FUTURES",
                "usdcm": "USDC-FUTURES",
                "coinm": "COIN-FUTURES",
            }
            target_product = product_type_map.get(mt)
            if target_product:
                tickers = [t for t in tickers if t.get("product_type") == target_product]

        if symbol:
            tickers = [t for t in tickers if t.get("symbol") == symbol]
            if not tickers:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Symbol not found")

        return json_response_with_decimals(
            content={
                "exchange": ex,
                "tickers": tickers,
                "count": len(tickers),
                "requested_filter": market_type,
                "api_filter": api_filter,
            },
            headers={
                "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=5",
                "Vary": "Accept, Authorization",
            },
        )
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"TICKER-API-ERROR: {e}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Ticker API error: {e}")


@market_router.get("/ticker/legacy")
async def get_ticker_legacy(
    exchange: Optional[str] = Query(
        None,
        description="Optional legacy override for exchange. If not set, uses default from ExchangeFactory.",
    ),
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Legacy Endpoint – liefert Tickerliste für die Default-Exchange
    (oder die per Query gesetzte Exchange).
    Keine harte Bitget-Abhängigkeit.
    """
    ex = exchange or get_default_exchange()
    result = await get_ticker(exchange=ex, symbol=None, market_type="spot")
    body = json.loads(result.body)
    return body.get("tickers", [])


# =========================
# SYMBOLS HANDLING
# =========================


@market_router.get("/symbols")
async def get_symbols(
    exchange: Optional[str] = Query(
        None,
        description="Exchange name (binance|bitget|bybit|okx|etc). If omitted, default from ExchangeFactory is used.",
    ),
    market: Optional[str] = Query(
        None,
        description="Filter by market type (spot|usdtm|coinm|usdcm|futures)",
    ),
    user_id: Optional[str] = Depends(get_client_id),
):
    """
    Unified Symbols Endpoint – kombiniert Logik aus:
    - market.symbols
    - unified_symbols.get_symbols
    Voll generisch, keine harte Standard-Exchange.
    """
    try:
        ex = exchange or get_default_exchange()

        api = ExchangeFactory.get_rest_api(ex, user_id=user_id)
        if not api:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Exchange not supported")

        # Safe API call mit optionalem market_filter
        try:
            symbols = await api.fetch_symbols(market_filter=market)
        except TypeError:
            symbols = await api.fetch_symbols()
            if market:
                symbols = [s for s in symbols if s.get("type") == market]

        return {
            "exchange": ex,
            "symbols": symbols,
            "count": len(symbols),
        }
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Symbols API error: {e}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Failed to retrieve symbols: {str(e)}")


@market_router.get("/symbols/canonize")
async def canonize_symbol(
    exchange: str = Query(..., description="Exchange (binance|bitget|bybit|okx|etc)"),
    market: str = Query("spot", description="Market type (spot|usdtm|coinm|usdcm)"),
    native_symbol: str = Query(..., description="Native symbol on exchange"),
):
    """
    Symbol Canonization – liefert asset_key und instrument_uid via SYMBOL_REGISTRY.
    """
    try:
        try:
            market_enum = Market(market.lower())
        except ValueError:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Invalid market. Use 'spot', 'usdtm', 'coinm', or 'usdcm'",
            )

        catalog = await SYMBOL_REGISTRY.catalog(exchange, market_enum)
        symbol_info = next(
            (x for x in catalog if x.get("native_symbol") == native_symbol.upper()),
            None,
        )

        if not symbol_info:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=404,
                detail=f"Symbol {native_symbol} not found on {exchange} ({market})",
            )

        return {
            "asset_key": symbol_info["asset_key"],
            "instrument_uid": symbol_info["instrument_uid"],
            "exchange": exchange,
            "market": market_enum.value,
            "native_symbol": native_symbol.upper(),
            "base": symbol_info["base"],
            "quote": symbol_info["quote"],
            "type": symbol_info["type"],
            "linear": symbol_info["linear"],
        }
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Canonization error for {exchange}:{native_symbol}: {e}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"Canonization failed: {str(e)}")


@market_router.get("/symbols/test")
async def test_symbols_connection():
    """Schneller Funktionstest für Symbol-Service (nutzt Default-Exchange, keine Hardcodierung)."""
    try:
        ex = get_default_exchange()
        data = await get_symbols(exchange=ex)
        return {"status": "success", "symbol_count": data["count"], "exchange": ex}
    except Exception as e:
        logger.critical(f"Symbols connection test failed: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Symbols service unavailable")


@market_router.get("/symbols/health")
async def symbols_health():
    """Health-Check für Symbol Resolution (Default-Exchange via Factory)."""
    try:
        ex = get_default_exchange()
        catalog = await SYMBOL_REGISTRY.catalog(ex, Market.SPOT)
        return {
            "status": "healthy",
            "symbol_registry_working": len(catalog) > 0,
            "cached_symbols": len(catalog),
            "exchange": ex,
            "version": "v1",
        }
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Symbols health check failed: {e}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Symbols health check failed")

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import platform
import time
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Dict

import psutil
from fastapi import APIRouter, Request

from backend.websocket.ws_registry import ws_registry

logger = logging.getLogger("monitoring-router")

monitoring_router = APIRouter(
    prefix="/monitoring",  # ✅ KORREKT - Registry fügt /api davor
    tags=["Monitoring"],
)

# Startzeit des Prozesses für Uptime-Berechnung
PROCESS_START_TIME = time.time()


def _get_system_metrics() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Liefert Basis-Systemmetriken (CPU, RAM, Uptime, Plattform).
    """
    now = datetime.utcnow()
    process = psutil.Process()

    uptime_seconds = time.time() - PROCESS_START_TIME
    mem = psutil.virtual_memory()

    return {
        "timestamp": now.isoformat(),
        "uptime_seconds": uptime_seconds,
        "platform": {
            "system": platform.system(),
            "release": platform.release(),
            "python_version": platform.python_version(),
        },
        "cpu": {
            "percent": psutil.cpu_percent(interval=None),
            "count_logical": psutil.cpu_count(logical=True),
            "count_physical": psutil.cpu_count(logical=False),
        },
        "memory": {
            "total": mem.total,
            "available": mem.available,
            "percent": mem.percent,
            "used": mem.used,
            "free": mem.free,
        },
        "process": {
            "pid": process.pid,
            "cpu_percent": process.cpu_percent(interval=None),
            "memory_rss": process.memory_info().rss,
            "num_threads": process.num_threads(),
        },
    }


def _get_ws_metrics() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Liest Metriken aus dem WebSocket-Registry-System aus.
    """
    try:
        health = ws_registry.get_system_health()
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error(f"Error while fetching WS registry metrics: {exc}")
        health = {
            "status": "error",
            "error": str(exc),
        }
    return health


@monitoring_router.get("/metrics")
async def get_websocket_metrics(request: Request) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Kombinierte Monitoring-Übersicht:
    - Systemmetriken (CPU, RAM, Prozess)
    - WebSocket-Lane-/Exchange-Metriken (via ws_registry)
    - (Optional) Cache-Middleware-Status
    """
    system_metrics = _get_system_metrics()
    ws_metrics = _get_ws_metrics()

    cache_info: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "status": "unknown",
        "middleware_found": False,
    }

    try:
        # Suche z. B. nach UltraFastASGICacheMiddleware im Middleware-Stack
        cache_middlewares = []
        for mw in getattr(request.app, "user_middleware", []):
            name = getattr(mw, "cls", type(mw)).__name__
            if "Cache" in name or "UltraFastASGICacheMiddleware" in name:
                cache_middlewares.append(name)

        if cache_middlewares:
            cache_info = {
                "status": "active",
                "middleware_found": True,
                "middlewares": cache_middlewares,
            }
        else:
            cache_info = {
                "status": "inactive",
                "middleware_found": False,
            }
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error(f"Error while inspecting cache middleware: {exc}")
        cache_info = {
            "status": "error",
            "error": str(exc),
        }

    return {
        "status": "ok",
        "system": system_metrics,
        "websocket": ws_metrics,
        "cache": cache_info,
    }


@monitoring_router.get("/health")
async def health_check() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Einfache Health-Check-Route für das Gesamtsystem.
    """
    system_metrics = _get_system_metrics()
    ws_metrics = _get_ws_metrics()

    status = "ok"
    details: Dict[str, Any] = {}

    # einfache Bewertung
    try:
        ws_status = ws_metrics.get("status")
        if ws_status not in (None, "ok", "healthy"):
            status = "degraded"
            details["ws_status"] = ws_status
    except Exception:
        pass

    return {
        "status": status,
        "timestamp": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
        "system": system_metrics,
        "websocket": ws_metrics,
        "details": details,
    }


@monitoring_router.get("/cache")
async def get_cache_monitoring(request: Request) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Monitoring-Endpunkt für Cache/Middleware.
    Erkennt Cache-Middleware (z. B. UltraFastASGICacheMiddleware) dynamisch
    über den FastAPI-Middleware-Stack.
    """
    now = datetime.utcnow()

    try:
        cache_middlewares = []
        for mw in getattr(request.app, "user_middleware", []):
            cls = getattr(mw, "cls", type(mw))
            name = getattr(cls, "__name__", str(cls))
            if "Cache" in name or "UltraFastASGICacheMiddleware" in name:
                cache_middlewares.append(name)

        if cache_middlewares:
            return {
                "status": "healthy",
                "timestamp": now.isoformat(),
                "middleware_stats": {
                    "status": "active",
                    "middlewares": cache_middlewares,
                    "note": "Cache middleware detected in application stack.",
                },
            }
        else:
            # Fallback wie im alten metrics.py:
            return {
                "status": "healthy",
                "timestamp": now.isoformat(),
                "middleware_stats": {
                    "status": "active",
                    "middleware_type": "UltraFastASGICacheMiddleware",
                    "note": "Cache stats collected at runtime via middleware",
                    "features": {
                        "memory_cache": "active",
                        "ttl_cache": "short TTL for hot endpoints",
                        "single_flight": "active for duplicate request deduplication",
                    },
                },
                "strategy_stats": {
                    "status": "static_hint",
                    "note": "Using generic cache strategy description as fallback.",
                },
            }
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error(f"Cache monitoring error: {exc}")
        return {
            "status": "error",
            "error": str(exc),
            "timestamp": now.isoformat(),
        }


@monitoring_router.get("/ws")
async def get_ws_metrics_alias(request: Request) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Alias für Kompatibilität (z. B. Endpoint-Mapping).
    Liefert identische Daten wie `/api/monitoring/metrics`,
    fokussiert auf WebSocket-relevante Metriken.
    """
    return await get_websocket_metrics(request)
